text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to rescind the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Winston Park Boulevard, west of Northgate Drive, to allow three-hour parking (unsigned) at all times. The proposed parking amendments will address the residents' concern with the lack of on-street parking for their guests and visitors and will not negatively impact the two-way flow of traffic.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north and west sides of Winston Park Boulevard, between Northgate Drive and Deverell Crescent (south intersection). 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the north and west sides of Winston Park Boulevard, between a point 275 metres west of Northgate Drive and Deverell Crescent (south intersection).
